bugs.description: _compare_check_constraints no longer returns early when conn_table is None (the table is new in the metadata), so it asks the inspector for the check constraints of a table that does not exist in the database and builds constraints against a None table.

_compare_check_constraints catches KeyError instead of the NotImplementedError that the base _InspectorConv.get_check_constraints in compare/util.py raises, so an inspector without check constraint support aborts autogenerate instead of skipping the comparison.
_add_check_constraint drops the op.schema guard, so a constraint without a schema is rendered with schema=None as an extra argument of create_check_constraint.
